title: Classification Extension
description: STAC Classification Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.

properties.$comment: This validates the fields in Item Properties, but does not require them.

assets.$comment: This validates the fields in Item Assets (including in Raster Band Objects), but does not require them.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Collections.

assets.$comment: This validates the fields in Collection Assets, but does not require them.

item_assets.$comment: This validates the fields in Item Asset Definitions, but does not require them.

summaries.$comment: This validates the fields in Summaries, but does not require them.

require_any_field.$comment: Please list all fields here so that we can force the existance of one of them in other parts of the schemas.

fields.$comment: Add your new fields here. Don't require them here, do that above in the corresponding schema.

classification:bitfields.title: Bit Mask
classification:bitfields.description: Classes stored in bit fields in the raster.

classification:classes.title: Classes
classification:classes.description: Classes stored in raster or bands.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the class. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

name.title: Name
name.description: Short name of the class for machine readability. Must consist only of letters, numbers, `-`, and `_` characters.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable name for use in, e.g., a map legend.

color_hint.title: Color Hint
color_hint.description: Suggested color for rendering (Hex RGB code in upper-case without leading #).

nodata.title: No-Data Values
nodata.description: If set to `true` classifies a value as a no-data value, defaults to `false`.

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: The percentage of data values that belong to this class in comparison to all data values, in percent (0-100).

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of data values that belong to this class.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Offset to first bit in the field.

length.title: Length
length.description: Number of bits in the field.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: Classes represented by the field values.

roles.title: Purpose
roles.description: Purpose of the bit field, expressed with roles like those of assets (for example `cloud` or `data-mask`).

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of the classification. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

name.title: Name
name.description: Short name of the class for machine readability. Must consist only of letters, numbers, `-`, and `_` characters.

raster_bands.$comment: Classification fields on the Raster Extension raster:bands object

ml_model_output.$comment: Classification fields on the MLM Extension mlm:output objects (https://crim-ca.github.io/mlm-extension/v1.0.0/schema.json).
ml_model_output.description: Describes the classes embedded in the output of the ML model following inference.
